summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @ornikar/jest-config-react-native@17.0.12 declares a `preinstall` script that runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub release (bun-v1.3.13), extracts the platform-appropriate `bun` binary to a temp path, marks it executable (chmod 0o755), and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])`. The `setup.mjs` wrapper uses hex-mangled identifiers. The executed `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with string-array-shuffle obfuscation (rotator function shifting a large mixed constants table) and no readable source. The bundle is executed exclusively under the dropped alternate runtime and is not referenced by any documented Jest configuration code path. Because `preinstall` fires automatically on `npm install`, the obfuscated payload runs on every installer machine with the installer's privileges. A Jest configuration package has no functional need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or an opaque compiled bundle, and the alternate-runtime execution path bypasses Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
